title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT desktop app for Linux
summary: OpenAI has released a dedicated ChatGPT desktop app for Linux, addressing long-standing requests from the open-source developer community. The preview app supports major Linux distributions, including Ubuntu 24.04/26.04 LTS, Debian 13, and Fedora 43/44, and enables access to ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex. The launch follows Anthropic's earlier release of a Claude desktop app for Linux.
key_points: OpenAI has launched a ChatGPT desktop app for Linux, fulfilling a major request from the open-source community.
The app is currently in preview and supports Ubuntu 24.04/26.04 LTS, Debian 13, and Fedora 43/44.
The app provides access to ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex on Linux distributions.
The release is global and covers distributions that serve as bases for many downstream desktop variants.
Anthropic had previously released a Claude desktop app for Linux, making OpenAI's release a competitive response.
